summary: Backend-only E2E verification of Paras Mall Mining Session LAPSE/BURN (>=24h). All 5 new API-level pytest cases PASS against the live preview env, and the existing 6-check unit test also PASSES. Behaviour matches spec: (a) my-bookings returns session_expired=true + accumulated=0 + can_start_session=true on aged bookings, (b) collect returns HTTP 400 with the exact required detail 'Session expired — points lapsed. Please start a new mining session.' AND clears session_start in Mongo AND increments laps_count, (c) start-session on a lapsed booking auto-clears and starts fresh (already_active=false), (d) 23h59m30s edge case still mines (>0 PRC, not expired).
critical_code_review_comments: compute_session_accumulated() at paras_mall.py:391-392 correctly returns (0.0, int(elapsed)) when elapsed>=SECONDS_PER_DAY — clean and unambiguous.

collect_booking() at paras_mall.py:1051-1064 uses a compound $set + $inc update to atomically clear session_start, record last_session_lapsed_at, and bump laps_count before raising HTTPException(400). Verified in DB: laps_count increments by exactly 1, session_start becomes null, next_session_available_at is cleared (so no cooldown for lapsed sessions — matches spec).

start_booking_session() at paras_mall.py:1136-1152 handles the 'existing session that has already lapsed' path by silently clearing the stale session and continuing to the normal fresh-start flow. Result: user sees already_active=false and a brand-new session_start — exactly the intended UX (no cooldown wall on burned points).
my_bookings() at paras_mall.py:967-970 correctly ORs `session_expired` into `can_start_session`, so the frontend receives can_start_session=true immediately on a lapsed booking (verified live).

Minor code hygiene: maybe_lapse_or_renew_session() at paras_mall.py:398-403 is now a no-op stub kept for compat with existing call-sites. Consider inlining/removing when convenient (dead-code smell) but harmless.

Test file /app/backend/tests/test_mall_mining_burn_e2e_api.py is the canonical E2E regression for the 24h burn behaviour and should be re-run any time paras_mall.py:compute_session_accumulated / collect_booking / start_booking_session / my_bookings is touched. Command: `pytest backend/tests/test_mall_mining_burn_e2e_api.py -v`. Fixture handles snapshot/restore of the mutated booking. Frontend UI (ParasMallBookings.js — red banner data-testid='mall-session-expired-{booking_id}', green 'Start New Mining Session' button data-testid='mall-start-session-btn-{booking_id}', hidden Collect on expired) was NOT visually verified in this iteration since main agent scoped the request to backend-only. Recommend a quick smoke Playwright pass on /mall/my-bookings if time permits — the backend flags feeding that UI (session_expired, can_start_session) are confirmed correct.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bug found. Spec fully implemented and verified end-to-end. compute_session_accumulated() gates on elapsed>=SECONDS_PER_DAY (86400s) and returns (0.0, int(elapsed)); collect_booking() raises HTTPException(400, 'Session expired — points lapsed. Please start a new mining session.') after atomic $set(session_start=null, last_session_lapsed_at=now) and $inc(laps_count:1); start_booking_session() detects lapsed session by re-checking elapsed vs SECONDS_PER_DAY and silently clears+resumes; my_bookings() sets session_expired=elapsed>=SECONDS_PER_DAY and can_start_session=session_expired OR (no cooldown && !active). All four surfaces align.
